dialogues.jp:
工藤と楽しそうに話していることりの笑顔が頭
から離れず。
dialogues.en:
The sight of her and Kudou smiling and happily chatting
still wouldn't leave my brain.
dialogues.text:
The sight of her and Kudou smiling and happily chatting
still wouldn't leave my brain.

dialogues.jp:
ことりに会う勇気が持てなくて、昨日のデート
をすっぽかしてしまった俺は……。
dialogues.en:
I wasn't able to build up the courage to face her for
yesterday's date...
dialogues.text:
I wasn't able to build up the courage to face her for
yesterday's date...

dialogues.jp:
その埋め合わせとして、今日、商店街に連れて
こられていた。
dialogues.en:
To make amends for that, today, I was accompanying her to
the shopping district.
dialogues.text:
To make amends for that, today, I was accompanying her to
the shopping district.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「うふふ〜」
dialogues.en: "Ehehe~"
dialogues.text: "Ehehe~"

dialogues.jp:
ことりが、傍目から見たら怪しい笑みを浮かべ
る。
dialogues.en: Kotori had a suspicious smile on her face.
dialogues.text: Kotori had a suspicious smile on her face.

dialogues.jp: 俺は無理矢理作り笑いを浮かべると。
dialogues.en:
I mustered up all my willpower and forced a smile on mine as
well.
dialogues.text:
I mustered up all my willpower and forced a smile on mine as
well.

dialogues.jp:
「大丈夫か、ことり！　傷は深いぞ、しっかり
　しろ！」
dialogues.en: "It's okay, Kotori! The wound may be deep, but stay calm!"
dialogues.text: "It's okay, Kotori! The wound may be deep, but stay calm!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「傷が深かったら、しっかり出来ないよ」
dialogues.en:
"If the wound was deep, it'd be basically impossible to stay
calm."
dialogues.text:
"If the wound was deep, it'd be basically impossible to stay
calm."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ま、それもそうだな」
dialogues.en: "I suppose."
dialogues.text: "I suppose."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「で、どうしたんだ？　急ににへら〜っと笑い
　出して」
dialogues.en: "But anyway, what was with that weird giggling?"
dialogues.text: "But anyway, what was with that weird giggling?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「うわ。そこまで弛んだ顔してないと思うんだ
　けど……まぁ、いいや。幸せだから」
dialogues.en:
"Wahh, I thought my face was stronger at hiding things like
that... I'm just happy."
dialogues.text:
"Wahh, I thought my face was stronger at hiding things like
that... I'm just happy."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「幸せ？」
dialogues.en: "Happy?"
dialogues.text: "Happy?"

dialogues.jp:
春休みに、具体的に何をするわけでもなく、た
だぶらぶらと歩いているのが幸せなのか？
dialogues.en:
Spring break, with nothing in particular to do, just
randomly walking around, one can become happy from that?
dialogues.text:
Spring break, with nothing in particular to do, just
randomly walking around, one can become happy from that?

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そうだよ〜。幸せだよ〜。だって、ほら」
dialogues.en: "Of course~ Happiness~. Because, here."
dialogues.text: "Of course~ Happiness~. Because, here."

dialogues.jp:
そう言ってことりが見せたのは、握り合った俺
とことりの手だった。
dialogues.en: As she talked, she took my hand into hers.
dialogues.text: As she talked, she took my hand into hers.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「こうして大好きな人と手をつないで、一緒に
　いられるんだもん」
dialogues.en: "I'm holding hands with the person I love, being with him."
dialogues.text: "I'm holding hands with the person I love, being with him."

dialogues.jp:
そう言って笑うことりの笑顔は本当に幸せそう
で。
dialogues.en: Her smile as she talked showed that she was truly happy.
dialogues.text: Her smile as she talked showed that she was truly happy.

dialogues.jp:
フレンチトーストに、蜂蜜と生クリームとガム
シロップとその他色々な甘味料をめちゃくちゃ
ぶっかけたみたいに甘いものだった。
dialogues.en:
Not even french toast or honey could match the sweetness
dripping from her smile.
dialogues.text:
Not even french toast or honey could match the sweetness
dripping from her smile.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ね、朝倉君もそうでしょ？」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-kun, you feel the same way too?"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-kun, you feel the same way too?"

dialogues.jp: 甘い笑顔のまま、俺に聞いてくる。
dialogues.en: She talked to me, still smiling.
dialogues.text: She talked to me, still smiling.

dialogues.jp: だが、俺は──。
dialogues.en: But I--
dialogues.text: But I--

dialogues.jp: 「……ひとつ、聞いてもいいか」
dialogues.en: "...Please tell me something."
dialogues.text: "...Please tell me something."

dialogues.jp: まったく違うことを口にした。
dialogues.en: Yet again, I didn't say what I wanted to.
dialogues.text: Yet again, I didn't say what I wanted to.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「何？　何でも答えるよ？」
dialogues.en: "Yes? What do you want me to tell you?"
dialogues.text: "Yes? What do you want me to tell you?"

dialogues.jp: ことりが無邪気に小首を傾げる。
dialogues.en: Kotori innocently tilted her head to the side.
dialogues.text: Kotori innocently tilted her head to the side.

dialogues.jp: 「その……なんだ。工藤のこと……なんだが」
dialogues.en: "About... it's about Kudou... of sorts."
dialogues.text: "About... it's about Kudou... of sorts."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「工藤君？　工藤君がどうかした？」
dialogues.en: "Kudou-kun? What about him?"
dialogues.text: "Kudou-kun? What about him?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ことり、工藤のこと、好きか？」
dialogues.en: "Kotori, do you like Kudou?"
dialogues.text: "Kotori, do you like Kudou?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「うん、好きだよ」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, I like him."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, I like him."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ガーン……」
自分で擬音なんか呟いてみたりして。
dialogues.en: I silently whispered to myself.
dialogues.text: I silently whispered to myself.

dialogues.jp:
そうでもしなけりゃ、やってられない心境だっ
た。
dialogues.en: I didn't even know what to feel now.
dialogues.text: I didn't even know what to feel now.

dialogues.jp:
足元が泥沼と化して、ズブズブと沈み込んでい
く感じだった。いや、むしろ積極的に沈み込ん
でいきたかった。
dialogues.en:
My feet felt like they were in a huge bog, and I couldn't do
anything to get out of it.
dialogues.text:
My feet felt like they were in a huge bog, and I couldn't do
anything to get out of it.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「お友達としてね」
dialogues.en: "He's a good friend after all."
dialogues.text: "He's a good friend after all."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「そうかそうか、なるほどなるほど。ことりは
　お友達として工藤が好きなのか……ってお友
　達？！」
dialogues.en:
"Right, right, I see, I see. You like your friend Kudou...
wait, friend?!"
dialogues.text:
"Right, right, I see, I see. You like your friend Kudou...
wait, friend?!"

dialogues.jp:
俺が目を見開いて聞き返すと、ことりは驚いた
ように身をひいた。
dialogues.en:
My eyes opened twice as wide as I asked her quickly in
return, startling her.
dialogues.text:
My eyes opened twice as wide as I asked her quickly in
return, startling her.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「う、うん」
dialogues.en: "Y, yeah."
dialogues.text: "Y, yeah."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「お友達としてってことは、恋人ってことじゃ
　ないんだよな？」
dialogues.en: "So as a friend, but not as a lover?"
dialogues.text: "So as a friend, but not as a lover?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「当たり前だよ〜。私の恋人は、朝倉君しかい
　ないじゃない」
dialogues.en: "Well, obviously~ You're my boyfriend after all."
dialogues.text: "Well, obviously~ You're my boyfriend after all."

dialogues.jp: きゅっと、握っていた手を深く絡ませてくる。
dialogues.en: She gave my hand a little squeeze.
dialogues.text: She gave my hand a little squeeze.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あ〜。もしかして……」
dialogues.en: "Ah~, don't tell me..."
dialogues.text: "Ah~, don't tell me..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「な……なんだよ？」
dialogues.en: "W...what?"
dialogues.text: "W...what?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉君、ヤキモチ、焼いてくれたんだね？」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-kun, were you feeling jealous?"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-kun, were you feeling jealous?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「昨日デートしてくれなかったのも、それが原
　因だったりするんだね？」
dialogues.en: "Is that why you cancelled yesterday's date as well?"
dialogues.text: "Is that why you cancelled yesterday's date as well?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「な、何のことかなっ」
dialogues.en: "W, what are you talking about..."
dialogues.text: "W, what are you talking about..."

dialogues.jp:
大慌てでそっぽを向く。真っ赤に染まった頬を、
ことりに見られたくなかった。
dialogues.en:
In a state of tremendous confusion, I turned my head away. I
didn't want Kotori to see my incredibly red cheeks.
dialogues.text:
In a state of tremendous confusion, I turned my head away. I
didn't want Kotori to see my incredibly red cheeks.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「えへへ。じゃあ、そう言うことにしておいて
　あげよう」
dialogues.en: "Ehehe. If you say so, I'd believe you."
dialogues.text: "Ehehe. If you say so, I'd believe you."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、そう言うことにしておいてくれ」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, I say so, so please believe me."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, I say so, so please believe me."

dialogues.jp:
どういうことかは、この際深く追及しない方が、
俺のためだ。
dialogues.en: of course, my own words were just to save my own face.
dialogues.text: of course, my own words were just to save my own face.

dialogues.jp: けど……よかった。
dialogues.en: But... thank goodness.
dialogues.text: But... thank goodness.

dialogues.jp: 工藤とことりは何でもないのか……。
dialogues.en: Kotori and Kudou aren't a problem...
dialogues.text: Kotori and Kudou aren't a problem...

dialogues.jp: 「……ったく、心配して損したぜ」
dialogues.en: "...Pah, I worried for nothing."
dialogues.text: "...Pah, I worried for nothing."

dialogues.jp:
昨日のデートとか、今日これまでことりと過ご
してきた時間とか。
dialogues.en: I could've been spending time with Kotori yesterday as well.
dialogues.text: I could've been spending time with Kotori yesterday as well.

dialogues.jp:
モヤモヤしてたから楽しめなかった。まったく
無駄にしちまったな。
dialogues.en:
Instead, I was worrying needlessly over some stupidly
jealous feelings.
dialogues.text:
Instead, I was worrying needlessly over some stupidly
jealous feelings.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「心が読めないと不便だね」
dialogues.en:
"It's hard not being able to know what other people are
thinking."
dialogues.text:
"It's hard not being able to know what other people are
thinking."

dialogues.jp: ことりが小さく呟いた。
dialogues.en: Kotori whispered to herself.
dialogues.text: Kotori whispered to herself.

dialogues.en: "Mm?"
dialogues.text: "Mm?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ううん、何でもないよ」
dialogues.en: "Noo, it's nothing."
dialogues.text: "Noo, it's nothing."

dialogues.jp: 俺の手を引いて、走り出す。
dialogues.en: Leading me by the hand again, she started walking.
dialogues.text: Leading me by the hand again, she started walking.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「じゃあ、今までそのことばっかり気になって、
　全然デート楽しめなかったでしょ？」
dialogues.en:
"So, now you can stop worrying about that and have fun on
this date, alright?"
dialogues.text:
"So, now you can stop worrying about that and have fun on
this date, alright?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ほら、行こ。バイバイするまで、めいっぱい
　楽しまなくちゃ！」
dialogues.en:
"Until we say goodbye, let's enjoy ourselves to the
fullest!"
dialogues.text:
"Until we say goodbye, let's enjoy ourselves to the
fullest!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……ああ、そうだな！」
dialogues.en: "...Ahh, you're right!"
dialogues.text: "...Ahh, you're right!"

dialogues.jp: ◆無駄な心配◆
dialogues.en: ◆Pointless Worrying◆
dialogues.text: ◆Pointless Worrying◆

dialogues.jp:
せっかくのことりとのデートだっていうのに、
俺は工藤とのことが気になっていた……。
dialogues.en:
After a while, Kotori and I finally went out on a date, but
I was still worried about Kotori and Kudou...
dialogues.text:
After a while, Kotori and I finally went out on a date, but
I was still worried about Kotori and Kudou...

dialogues.jp: タイミングを見つけて、切り出す。
dialogues.en: But the timing of Kotori's response threw me off.
dialogues.text: But the timing of Kotori's response threw me off.

dialogues.jp:
工藤とはただの友達だという。恋人は俺だけだ
と……。
dialogues.en: Kudou was just a friend, while I was her lover...
dialogues.text: Kudou was just a friend, while I was her lover...

dialogues.jp: ちくしょう。嬉しいじゃねえか。
dialogues.en: Bah, I wasted so much time.
dialogues.text: Bah, I wasted so much time.
